name: mcode-stack
description: Workflows and skills the MiniMax Code team uses to build MiniMax Code. Each stack installs as one plugin.

plugins.name: ronny
plugins.description: Daily workflows and self-check skills from the MiniMax Code R&D lead: independent review, subagent split checks, tool and context budget audits, long sessions, long commands, harness experiments, trajectory review, plus everyday engineering practice for code review, review comments, small PRs, change descriptions and emergency changes.

plugins.name: jiachen
plugins.description: Find the loops where you keep acting as a manual step for your agents (retrying, judging, approving, carrying context) and lift yourself out of them, plus a content pipeline that rewrites AI-sounding Chinese drafts and turns material into Xiaohongshu image posts and short vertical videos.
